profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
Problems go in. Solutions come out.

Dedicated Full Stack Engineer with 7 years of hands-on experience in designing and developing robust web applications. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams through collaboration with stakeholders to identify project constraints and customer needs, translating them into effective software solutions within an Agile framework. Specialized in API integrations, adept at discovery/documentation, and skilled in project design/planning. 

Committed to mentoring teammates to ensure the delivery of maintainable, scalable, and high-quality projects. Known for fostering a growth-focused, collaborative team environment. 

Seeking opportunities to leverage my expertise in creating innovative solutions for dynamic projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - IAM
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Ruby · Identity and Access Management (IAM)

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Innovar Solutions is an Operational Improvement firm specializing in helping clients reduce costs, enhance revenue and improve the overall quality of service they deliver.

I lead design, development and implementation activities for our software solutions. We design innovative solutions that are tightly coupled with the client’s operational processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Shopping Homepage Team
positions.description: I am part of Amazon's Core Shopping Team to remediate accessibility compliance issues on Homepage (World-Wide) for the European Accessibility Act. My duties include software development in a complex microservice environment (primarily TS/JS, CICD, Git), analyzing and scoping existing accessibility tickets to develop go-forward plans and burndowns, creating a remediation plan for the overall project, developing a long-term comprehensive strategy that includes technical and non-technical guidance to align cross-functional global teams, documentation and reporting to external teams and leadership, identifying gaps in mechanisms for web accessibility compliance, identifying solutions and mechanisms to enforce compliance, and collaborating with diverse teams and departments in Amazon to resolve critical compliance issues.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · Git · Documentation · Project Planning

positions.title: Bereavement
positions.description: Family loss.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Full stack development and maintenance for four React SPAs, supported by a microservice mesh of 15+ Dockerized PHP/Node/Typescript services, with a MySql/Solr ETL/Redis persistence layer deployed to EKS KuberS cluster on AWS.

Special focus on ownership of the code, refactoring and migrating legacy systems, API integrations, tenacious bug hunting, technical and design documentation, cross-functional and cross-departmental communication, and onboarding/mentorship for new hires.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented new mobile-first features for multiple web applications following internal pattern guides with headless CMS.
Developed and implemented queries and algorithms used across multiple marketplace frontends to power client search results and internal reporting.
Migrated +20 services from Rancher to Docker/Kubernetes.
Created and updated onboarding documents and knowledge resources.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, implementation, and documentation of legacy email system conversion from HTTP to REST, B2C waterfall campaigns, and B2B notifications leveraging Ruby on Rails, Sendgrid/Twilio/Mailparser, and APIs. API design and development to process customer data using Ruby on Rails, AWS products and Resque with a focus on performance and scalability. Implementation of new features and maintenance of multiple SPA/MPA websites with Ruby on Rails, JavaScript (Vanilla, Node),and jQuery.

Scrum master and light PM duties including leading daily standups, facilitating Sprint planning, communication follow ups, collaborating with stakeholders and creating onboarding docs for new hires.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implementation to automate time-consuming, company-wide internal reporting through the creation of new MySQL and MongoDB data models, APIs, cronjobs, and email technologies saving +30 business hours/week across all product owners.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Project: QA internal reporting system after Rails upgrade
Project: Create scheduled jobs to update Client information using current gems/packages and ActiveRecord

positions.title: Independent Consultant/Event Organizer
positions.description:
Big Data event organization: planning and execution of events and conferences for up to 600+ attendees from SMB-to-enterprise companies including classes, events, and outside vendors regularly generating $100-150k revenue from each event with annual increased attendance.

Provide company branding including designing logos, website consultation, and copyediting.

Leveraged Kanban system to drive project management for event preparation and execution. Secured, trained and managed floor staff to ensure seamless execution between the event space and the client. Responsible for sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offers management of staff as well as maintaining their time ledgers and ensuring payment.

Assisted with event photographers and videographers to ensure the best possible results for the client. Sponsor liaison for client events including ensuring organized set-ups, tear-downs, shipping/receiving, lunches, and general experience satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Event Planning · Event Management · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Public Speaking · Problem Solving

volunteerExperiences.description:
Country Girls Code panelist and event teacher for  introducing high school girls from rural Central Texas schools to the basics of programming and careers in programming.
 
We produce low-cost/free staff development opportunities for teachers and other education leaders and provide grants to those who would otherwise not be able to attend quality professional development events. We also offer grants for teachers to use to purchase technology equipment for their classrooms.  
 
In addition, we work with students to help them explore careers and grow skills to prepare for life beyond high school through our program "Country Girls Code."
